# SYNESIS_E023 — Error

## Description

Empty ITEM block — no fields.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
This ITEM block is empty — it has no field with content.
  An ITEM without fields represents no unit of analysis.
  Add the fields required by the template or remove the block if it
  was created by mistake.
```
